intent: Individually teach friendship/person/adjective distinctions,recorded classmates versus assigned partners,guest-room modifier versus possession,host noun versus verb,visitor versus visit with each-singular,stranger versus strange with a polite private-address refusal,and explicit full-name components. Original three-student art supports neutral referent selections; class and partner facts remain authored records. Original writing,changed rewrites and a fresh open-day record remain draft and credit free.
picturePurpose: Three separate original fictional students with blue/green/violet clothes and teal/coral/blue blank notebooks distinguish referents. Written class records and current partner assignments determine relationships; neither appearance nor standing nearby proves a class or partnership.

workshop.title: 先认清人物关系，再看这次怎么分工
workshop.instruction: 读记录、选判断，再填句子。班级、搭档和活动角色分别核对；每完成一项，换成自己的例子试一试。

items.label: friendship：写关系，不是写某一个人
items.prompt: Yun和Bo在郊游时成为朋友。要说“他们的友谊始于那次郊游”，哪句用对了表示关系的名词？

wordDecision.prompt: Yun和Bo在郊游时成为朋友。要说“他们的友谊始于那次郊游”，哪句用对了表示关系的名词？

items.material: Their friendship began on a rainy school trip.
items.after: began on a rainy school trip.
items.reason: friend是朋友，friendship是友谊。这里写一段关系的开始，用Their friendship began，而不是friend或friendly。
items.hint: friend + ship → friendship；这里指关系，不是人。

options.text: Their friendship began on that school trip.
options.reason: friendship指友谊这段关系，friend指朋友这个人。

options.text: Their friend began on that school trip.
options.reason: friend是朋友，不是题目要表达的友谊；这里需要friendship。

options.text: Their friendly began on that school trip.
options.reason: friendly通常作形容词，不能在这里充当“友谊”这个名词。

items.label: classmate：同年级不一定同班
items.prompt: 记录：左一Yun在8A班；中间Bo在8A班；右一Lea在8B班。谁是Yun的classmate？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：左一Yun在8A班；中间Bo在8A班；右一Lea在8B班。谁是Yun的classmate？

items.reason: classmate由class和mate组成，表示同班同学。查班级记录：Yun和Bo同在8A；Lea在8B，不能只凭同年级判断。

options.text: Lea, because everyone in Grade 8 is in the same class.

options.text: Both Bo and Lea, because class and grade mean the same thing.

options.text: Bo, because Bo and Yun are both in Class 8A.

items.before: Check the last sentence with your

items.before: We put fresh towels in the

items.label: host：同一个词，可以是人也可以是动作
items.prompt: ①The host introduced the speakers. ②Our school will host the show. 两处host分别表示什么？

wordDecision.prompt: ①The host introduced the speakers. ②Our school will host the show. 两处host分别表示什么？

items.material: The host introduced each speaker clearly.
items.reason: The host指主持人，是名词；will host指将主办，是动词。动词也可变成hosts、hosted或hosting，要按句子选。
items.hint: the host指人；will host表示将主办。

options.text: ① organise the show; ② the presenter
options.reason: 把两处词性颠倒了：①是人，②是主办这个动作。

options.text: ① an invited guest; ② visit the show
options.reason: guest是受邀客人；host这里分别是主持人和主办，不能都读成来访。

options.text: ① the presenter; ② organise the show
options.reason: ①the host指主持人；②will后接动词host，表示主办。

transfer.stem: Which note agrees with today’s new record?
transfer.passage:
OPEN DAY: NEW RECORD
Lin and Hui are in Class 8B. Dong is in Class 8A. For today’s task, Hui works with Dong; Lin works alone. Our school will host a reading show. Hui is the student host and introduces Ms Qiao, our invited guest speaker. Each visitor receives a map. A visitor’s form says: Given name: Lily. Family name: Brown. Please write her full name on the map.

options.text: Lin and Hui are classmates; Hui’s partner is Dong.
Hui and Dong are classmates because they are both in Grade 8.
Ms Qiao must be the host because she is an invited guest.
The visitor’s full name is Lily; Brown is not needed.

answer.display: Lin and Hui are classmates; Hui’s partner is Dong.

explanation.strategy: 把同班、搭档、主持人与客人分开查，再按表格核对全名。

steps.text: Lin和Hui都在8B班；本次Hui的搭档却是8A班的Dong。
steps.reason: Class 8B给出同班关系；Hui works with Dong给出这次合作安排。

steps.text: 学校主办，Hui主持，Ms Qiao受邀发言；Lily Brown才是表中的全名。
steps.reason: will host是主办动作；student host与invited guest speaker是不同角色；名和姓都要保留。

distractors.reason: 同属八年级不能证明同班：Hui在8B，Dong在8A。
受邀客人不自动成为主持人；记录明确Hui主持，Ms Qiao是受邀发言者。
表格给出名Lily和姓Brown；只写Lily没有填完整全名。

explanation.pitfall: 同年级不等于同班，搭档也不一定同班；客人和主持人要按本次角色记录区分。
